headline: Committee postponed a decision on swapping government meetings to Channel 85 and public access programming to Channel 3.
summary: The committee discussed a memo proposing to move government programming from Channel 3 to Channel 85. Members also discussed repairs to the studio building, where two removal bids came in at $58,000 and $93,000. The channel question was postponed to a later meeting.
decisions: Postponed the vote on moving government and public access programming to different channels.
discussion: Studio building repairs: Two bids for removal work were $58,000 and $93,000, and the committee discussed using about $40,000 in equipment funds and phasing the work.
Channel swap: Views differed on whether to separate government and public access content between Channel 3 and Channel 85, or keep them together on Channel 3.
Public access funding: Members discussed the $180,000 budget and whether the general fund money should be paid back.
Cable franchise renegotiation: The committee discussed whether to reopen the franchise agreement and what demands to make, noting the 5% of gross revenue that supports public access.

decision_evidence.quote: So can we punt on this matter of second? Yes. Yeah. Yeah.

decision_titles: Swapping government and public access channels

problems.what: continued, but the decision or the minutes don't say so
